# Aspect model JSON schemas

The generated JSON schemas (`gen/<Aspect>-schema.json`) of the JustInSequencePart versions the app
reads, from
[eclipse-tractusx/sldt-semantic-models](https://github.com/eclipse-tractusx/sldt-semantic-models)
at commit `ff04cc7c4915eb29ed2b5656d9e7d45b31079c04` (the same commit as `../aspects`), named
`<namespace>-<version>-schema.json`. The tests validate the official examples and the demo data
(`devtools/mock_participant.py`) against them.

They are licensed under [CC-BY-4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode)
by the Eclipse Tractus-X contributors and are used unmodified.
